plan.notes: MERGE NOTE: official sample 2-year sequence totals 62 credits (published term totals 18/15/16/13); catalog degree requirement is 61-62 (only one of MAT 203 or MAT 205 required), but the official sequence prints BOTH MAT 203 and MAT 205 as full entries — carried at the sequence own 62-credit total per merge-time rule; 61-credit one-math path documented below. Source: official Greenfield Community College 2025-26 Catalog (PDF) - Computer Science program page, 'Degree Map: Computer Science (Sample 2 Year Course Sequence)'. Program degree designation is Associate in Science, 61-62 total credits, 'Includes Mass STEM General Education Foundation'. Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the catalog's semester-by-semester degree map (pages 114-117 of the PDF). Catalog year set to 2025-2026 (the catalog the degree map belongs to). Credit math: semester totals are the degree map's own published values (Year 1 Fall 18, Year 1 Spring 15, Year 2 Fall 16, Year 2 Spring 13) = 62 credits, matching the degree map's own General Education 34 / Major 20 / Elective 8 split (34+20+8=62). Caveats: (1) The catalog's program requirements list a total of 61-62 credits because 'Program Requirements II' requires at least ONE of MAT 203 or MAT 205; the sample 2-year degree map itself includes BOTH MAT 203 (as major) and MAT 205 (as elective), landing at 62. This file transcribes the official term-by-term degree map as printed, i.e. the 62-credit path. (2) 'ENG Comp II' slot: catalog requirement review forms list ENG 112, ENG 114, or ENG 116 (English Composition II); credit for only one of ENG 112/114/116; all require ENG 101. (3) CSC 251 and CSC 252 prereq is 'CSC 101 or permission of instructor' - modeled here as CSC 101, per-file. (4) CSC 254 official catalog prereq is 'CSC 251 (or CIS 251); and MAT 107 or satisfactory placement' - the MAT 107 piece is satisfied by placement for students entering the sequence at MAT 201, so only CSC 251 is modeled as the course prereq here. (5) MAT 201 official prereq: grade of C or better in MAT 108 OR satisfactory placement (plus ENG 090/ENG 094 or placement) - MAT 108 is listed in external_prereqs; ENG 090/ENG 094 are developmental and also listed in external_prereqs; placement is an alternative documented here. (6) PHY 111 prereq: MAT 201 or concurrent enrollment in MAT 201 (shown in the same fall semester); PHY 112 prereq: PHY 111 and MAT 202 or concurrent enrollment in MAT 202; CSC 201 prereq: MAT 201 and MAT 202 (or concurrent enrollment in MAT 202). (7) CSC 101 official prereq: ENG 090 and ENG 094, or satisfactory placement. (8) Behavioral and Social Science / Humanities and Fine Arts choice slots are any 3-credit courses from those General Education Electives lists in the catalog; two BSS courses (6 credits) and two HFA courses (6 credits) total per the catalog requirement review form. The degree is a transfer program for the Bachelor of Science in computer science and meets the requirements of the Computer Science Block approved by the Massachusetts Board of Higher Education.
